fields.description: Weekly issue featuring editorials and commentary on Greater Miami politics and civic life following the primary election. Major pieces criticize the Coral Gables city commission’s removal of developer George Merrick and discuss municipal governance. Coverage includes the nomination of Ruth Bryan Owen for Congress, local law-enforcement actions (including slot-machine raids), debates over assisting the Elks convention compared with Shrine funding, and notes on bootlegging/liquor prices and Prohibition. Additional items address public health and morality concerns (prostitution), Chamber of Commerce growth, local entertainment, and assorted society/personal columns and advertisements.
